rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for a protective mask worn over the nose and mouth.

example.english: I usually wear a mask when I go out to protect myself and others.
example.traditional: 我出街通常都會戴口罩，保護自己同人哋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui6 daai3 hau2 zaau3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 tung4 jan4 dei6

rows.note: Use this for a disguise or costume mask, rather than an everyday protective 口罩.

example.english: They wore a scary mask to the Halloween party.
example.traditional: 萬聖節嗰晚，佢戴住一個鬼仔面具去派對。
example.jyutping: maan6 sing3 zit3 go2 maan5 keoi5 daai3 zyu6 jat1 go3 gwai2 zai2 min6 geoi6 heoi3 paai3 deoi3

rows.note: Use this technical term for an image-editing mask that hides part of an image or controls transparency.

example.english: Add a mask when editing the picture to hide the unwanted part.
example.traditional: 做相嗰陣加個遮罩，就可以遮住唔想要嘅部分。
example.jyutping: zou6 soeng2 go2 zan6 gaa1 go3 ze1 zaau3 zau6 ho2 ji5 ze1 zyu6 m4 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 bou6 fan6
